assessment: post-election preliminary winner-party direction, not certified margin errors
as_of: 2026-11-04 (site's archived Nov. 4 call ledger; individual call timestamps absent)
method: Full modeled-house (435), modeled-Senate (17) and 2026 governor (36) row registry. For House and Democratic-vs-Republican Senate contests, compared party directions are scored only when a named, linked winner call is in the site's local ledger; governor adjusted margins are intentionally withheld because only raw publisher polling and separate governor-specific historical inputs are locked. No verified final D-R vote shares for all races, so margin error fields are null; same-party and independent candidate contests are not treated as ordinary D-R comparisons. Ledger missing does not imply a major decision desk has not called a race.
